name: autonomic
desc: [自主神经] 反射循环：tick单次反射/start守护/stop/pause/resume/status；L1可逆自动L2提议
cmd: A=$action; B=/data/lemonbrain/autonomic; PY=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/python3; case "$A" in start) sh $B/autonomic_ctl.sh start;; stop) sh $B/autonomic_ctl.sh stop;; pause) sh $B/autonomic_ctl.sh pause;; resume) sh $B/autonomic_ctl.sh resume;; status) /system/bin/timeout 20 $PY $B/autonomic.py status;; *) /system/bin/timeout 50 $PY $B/autonomic.py tick;; esac
